description: Main source code for a Bluetooth audio sink player that streams WAV files over Bluetooth, managing connection states, playback, and user interruption.

classes.name: context_t
classes.description: Holds context information for Bluetooth audio playback including file path, connection state, format, thread, and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: wav_header_t
classes.description: Represents the WAV file header structure with format details and data size.

methods.name: playback_task
methods.description: Thread function that handles streaming WAV data to Bluetooth sink, managing playback control and user interruption.

methods.name: audio_sink_disconnected
methods.description: Handles cleanup when Bluetooth sink disconnects.

methods.name: audio_sink_connected
methods.description: Handles actions upon Bluetooth sink connection.

methods.name: audio_sink_state_changed
methods.description: Callback for Bluetooth sink state changes, triggers connection/disconnection handling.

methods.name: audio_sink_operational_state_update
methods.description: Callback for Bluetooth sink operational state updates, manages registration and unregistration of callbacks.

methods.name: ctrl_c_handler
methods.description: Handles user interrupt (Ctrl+C) to stop playback.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main program entry that initializes Bluetooth sink, loads WAV file, manages connection, and starts playback thread.
